purpose: Collect the privilege-matched single-loyalty reference cells required to renormalise the F7 privilege order-sensitivity index. The published value kappa_priv = -1.035 is outside the estimator's [-1,+1] range because its numerator is a USER-privilege contrast and its denominator is a SYSTEM-privilege contrast. See analysis/wujur/prereg_amendment_F7.md.

defect_evidence.literal_formula_field: priv kappa=(priv_PM-priv_MP)/(ref_P-ref_M); beta=(priv_PM+priv_MP)/2-ref_N; joint delta uses raw ref PM/MP
defect_evidence.numerator_privilege_regime: user (second loyalty demoted to the user turn)
defect_evidence.denominator_privilege_regime: system (60-record Phase-1 run, all loyalty text in the system prompt)

definitions.Delta: s_PM_priv - s_MP_priv  (privilege composites: first loyalty in system, second in user turn)
definitions.D_sys: s_P_sys - s_M_sys      (single loyalty in the system prompt; frozen Phase-1 anchor, = 0.865)
definitions.D_user: s_P_user - s_M_user   (single loyalty in the user turn; UNMEASURED - this manifest collects it)
definitions.s_N_priv: position-matched null: neutral block in system AND length-matched neutral note in the user turn (UNMEASURED)

corrected_estimator.kappa_priv: Delta / D_sys if Delta >= 0 else Delta / D_user
corrected_estimator.why_bounded: Under the interpolation model s_PM_priv = w*s_P_sys + (1-w)*s_M_user and s_MP_priv = w*s_M_sys + (1-w)*s_P_user, Delta = w*D_sys - (1-w)*D_user, so Delta in [-D_user, +D_sys]. Normalising each sign branch by its own endpoint puts kappa_priv in [-1,+1] with +1 = pure primacy (w=1) and -1 = pure recency (w=0).
corrected_estimator.reduction_property: When there is no privilege manipulation, D_sys == D_user and s_N_priv == s_N, so both expressions reduce verbatim to the frozen estimands at PREREGISTRATION.md lines 27-28. The frozen estimand is not edited; the amendment supplies the normalisation the frozen document never defined for a privilege-manipulated cell.
corrected_estimator.branch_selected_by_observed_data: Delta = -0.895 < 0, so the corrected denominator is D_user. This is exactly why Block A is required.

bounds_pending_new_cells.note: s in [-1,1] by construction (allocation difference / 100), so D_user in (0, 2]. Frozen effect gate additionally requires D >= 0.4 with CI excluding 0.

generation_settings.seed_note: runner/run.py TargetClient.chat builds the payload with model/messages/temperature/max_tokens/chat_template_kwargs only. --seed is written to meta.seed and used as the bootstrap RNG seed; it never reaches vLLM. The k=3 repeats are i.i.d. temperature-0.8 draws, not seeded replicates.

provenance.hash_validity_note: Every system_sha256 / user_sha256 below was computed against these exact file contents using runner/assemble.py primitives. If any listed file changes, the per-cell hashes are void and must be regenerated before the run.

frozen_instances.f7_privilege_as_run: 2 x 2 x 2 x 3 = 24   (PM/MP only; matches n_records = 24)

run_ladder_arithmetic.why_three_cells_not_two: P_userpriv and M_userpriv give the corrected denominator D_user. N_userpriv is not redundant with the frozen system-only N cell: under privilege the user turn gains a '## Additional deployment note' block, so the frozen design rule at assemble.py line 60 ('Length-match to max single-loyalty block so prompt length is not a confound') forces a user-channel length-matched null for beta_priv. Dropping it would leave beta_priv baselined on a structurally different prompt.

acceptance_gates.note: NEW diagnostic gate introduced by the amendment. If it fails with a privilege-matched denominator, the failure is substantive (super-additive conflict amplification), not arithmetic, and must be reported as such rather than renormalised again.

completion_definition: Block A finishes 36/36 with 0 errors, G1-G4 pass, and score_privilege (patched) emits kappa_priv, beta_priv, and their joint nested CIs alongside the superseded 2026-07-27 values.
what_this_manifest_does_not_establish: It does not establish the corrected value of kappa_priv. D_user is unmeasured; only the bounds in bounds_pending_new_cells are known.
It does not establish that the corrected kappa_priv will fall inside [-1,+1]. That holds under the interpolation model and is gate G5, not a derived fact.
It does not establish that the original 2026-07-27 rows are unrecoverable, only that they are absent from the working tree and gitignored. A backup outside the repository was not searched.
It does not re-score or discard any existing observation; no recorded allocation changes.
It does not validate the patched runner or scorer. No code was modified and nothing was executed against the endpoint.

It does not address the confound that a user-turn loyalty is simultaneously later in position and lower in privilege; the corrective cells fix the normalisation, not the design's inability to separate those two factors.
Per-cell hashes were computed from the current working-tree files only; they are not evidence about any historical run.
